TC-14/S44.title: A dictated negative stays negative ('no chest pain', 'denies fever', 'not on anticoagulation')
TC-14/S44.detail: Dev <dev address> (main 8b4be94a), live models (every call Haiku 4.5 us.anthropic.claude-haiku-4-5-20251001-v1:0, no fallback; generateNote providerMs 7.1–15.1 s, parsePreRoundNotes 4.5–5.3 s), under runs/.dev.lock, browsers in UTC; datasets hallu-hosp + hallu-nh (new specs hallu-hosp/-nh.spec.ts + hallu-lib.ts), 10 synthetic fixtures (5 Hospital, 5 Nursing Home) × arm A (pre-round Save Note → summary → Encounter → Generate) and arm B (same words in the Encounter only → Generate); only prefixed rows created, all deleted (0 remaining, 0 changes to other rows). Trap verdicts by the fixture regexes, 13 'unclear'/false hits settled by the agent's reading (review.agent.json, a person confirms). Preston-kit judge (grade.mjs, claude-opus-5-5 ×2) on all 20 notes: 20/20 uncalibrated FAIL (U1 on every note, U2 on 16), beside, needs a person. 0/4 traps invented in either arm (no chest pain ×2, denies fever, not on anticoagulation): every note keeps the negative or leaves it out; no anticoagulant or VTE prophylaxis added. Provisional: substring/sentence pre-screen plus the kit judge's notes (uncalibrated); 4 traps only.
